packages.purpose: Measure repeatable heart-rate recovery after one frozen exercise protocol before considering any outcome association.

primarySources.name: Heart-rate recovery immediately after exercise as a predictor of mortality

missingDelta: explicit exercise subtype and protocol version
intensity or workload and exertion-end marker
frozen one-minute and later recovery windows

proposedStudy.design: Within-person repeatability study for one standardised exercise and recovery sequence.
proposedStudy.participants: Consenting adults able to perform the selected protocol safely.
proposedStudy.reference: Versioned exercise phase markers, workload, and observed heart-rate recovery; no mortality label.
proposedStudy.split: Participant-held-out protocol validation plus repeated sessions per participant.

packages.purpose: Measure repeatability of nocturnal movement timing and coverage without presenting movement-only data as a validated sleep-regularity index.

primarySources.name: Irregular sleep/wake patterns are associated with poorer academic performance and delayed circadian and sleep/wake timing
primarySources.use: sleep/wake regularity metric identity and study-design context only

missingDelta: frozen movement timestamps units axes sample rate and missingness
prespecified nocturnal movement-repeatability formula or separately collected all-day sleep/wake states

proposedStudy.design: Repeated-night feasibility and repeatability study for one frozen nocturnal movement descriptor.
proposedStudy.participants: Consenting participants with enough complete nights under one compatible movement contract.
proposedStudy.reference: Versioned movement events and, in a later calibration, separately collected sleep/wake state; raw movement never invents an SRI label.
proposedStudy.split: Participant-held-out evaluation with repeated nights retained within one participant partition.
proposedStudy.retention: Purpose-bound aligned movement summaries and provenance under governed study pseudonyms.

allowedNow: generated-only nightly movement coverage and event descriptors
prohibited: sleep regularity index from movement alone

mainCosts: separate sleep/wake reference for any SRI validation

promotionGate: frozen metric identity and minimum-night rule
scientific privacy security and ethics approval
blockers: historical movement provenance and units are not fully frozen

missingDelta: one versioned upload containing the complete six-rate curve

proposedStudy.design: Repeated six-rate within-person protocol with counterbalanced or frozen order.
proposedStudy.participants: Consenting participants with complete compatible guided-breathing sessions.
proposedStudy.reference: Prespecified curve features and repeat-session agreement, not a clinical endpoint.
proposedStudy.split: Participant-held-out protocol evaluation; repeated sessions assess within-person stability.
proposedStudy.retention: Purpose-bound complete-curve records with governed study pseudonyms.
